title: Site cards are visible without JavaScript and in print (SCAN-1027)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. Every .pop card was opacity 0 until site-fx added .in, so with scripts blocked, failing or slow, and before hydration, feature cards, chapters and legal cards were blank. The hidden state now hangs on [data-pop], a flag site-fx sets on the kit root before it observes anything, and a print rule shows every card. Reduced-motion visitors never get the flag.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/kit-site.css','utf8');const f=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/site/shell/site-fx.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(/\\.pop\\{position:relative;opacity:0/.test(c))bad.push('cards are hidden with no script flag');if(!c.includes('[data-pop] .pop{opacity:0'))bad.push('hidden state is not behind data-pop');if(!c.includes('@media print{'))bad.push('no print rule');if(!f.includes(\"setAttribute('data-pop'\"))bad.push('site-fx never sets the flag');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1027: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when site cards are hidden before the script has taken charge, or print loses its rule.
